basic_info.description: Just reduced $100k!  This remodeled 2BR Edwardian flat is loc in the heart of Duboce Triangle, on a peaceful, tree-lined street steps from the best of SF services & pub trans.  Condo conversion expected to complete in 9 months.  Unit #2 is rear garden level, providing a serene respite.  The only unit w/dir access to a large private patio & deep yard.  Natural light streams into the modern open LR/DR/Kit floorplan.  Charming, orig Victorian details, hard & soft wood floors, tall coved ceilings, & period millwork abound. Bright, well laid-out chef's kitchen incl granite, custom cabs w/plenty of storage & s/s appliances. Excellent storage & in-unit washer/dryer.  Large foyer can provide office. A deeded indep parking space included!
